Shared checkout is back on main. Those two files are clean there. Not a landing candidate yet — waiting on a scoped interview JVM gate from a clean tree before I post evidence for ack.

d_sens (bd-01M16S2Y6YS82TE6WBWQPKNZR3) is the live writing bead. Compatibility + two type misfits are the reply to the option-3 ruling.
